title: ARCADE: HALLOWEEN DRESSING
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 20 of 20. An arcade raid now looks like Halloween night: every lamp burns orange and a little brighter, carved pumpkins sit by the lamps and doors (most of them lit, with a warm glow at night), and a slow violet haze drifts over the screen. It is all decoration drawn from the cosmetic dice, never the raid dice, so the map, the loot and the enemies are exactly the same and what you can see is unchanged. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade the lamps burn orange, carved pumpkins sit by lamps and doors, and a slow violet haze drifts over the screen, all purely decoration.
